claim_scores.rationale: Identical to the gold repro; it uses `dump_state()` from the source signature as the saved prompt state for the reorder test.
The asserts show positional loading: after reordering inputs, `context` gets the source question description and `question` gets the source context description.
It provides the complete runnable repro and asserts the exact swapped descriptions plus the unchanged `answer` description.
It prints and asserts that `loaded.instructions` becomes `"Source instructions"` after `load_state()`.
